programme.title: Olobobs
programme.desc: Mae'r Olobobs ar eu ffordd i gyfarfod Deno, Norbet a Lemon am ginio yn y goedwig. Mae gan bawb focs bwyd heblaw am Lemon. The Olobobs have lunch in the forest, but Lemon hasn't got lunch.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Mae'r Abadas yn chwarae môrladron ar y traeth. The Abadas are having a pirate adventure at the beach. Hari is first mate and Seren a pirate parrot.

programme.title: Dreigiau Cadi
programme.desc: Pan nad oes unrhyw ffordd o goginio selsig, mae'r Chef Cef yn dod i'r adwy! When there's no way of cooking sausages it's Chef Cef come to the rescue.

programme.title: Sion y Chef
programme.desc: Mae cnau coco'n arwain at noson o fwyd a cherddoriaeth calypso. Coconuts prove to be the key ingredient for a night of calypso food and music.

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Mae Hywel y ffermwr hud yn tywys Leisa ar antur i lan y môr i ddysgu iddi amdan gwymon. Hywel, the magical farmer, takes Leisa on an adventure to the seaside to teach her about seaweed.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae'r Pitws, Tada a Llywelyn yn eistedd ger y tân ac yn mwynhau stori Tada am y Bobo-Deuben! The Wee Littles, Pop-Pops & Mumford sit around a campfire at night engrossed in Pop-Pop's story.

programme.title: Odo
programme.desc: Mae hoff fand roc Dwdl yn dod i chwarae ym Maes y Mes ond mae rhaid adeiladu melin wynt er mwyn cynhyrchu trydan i gael y swn iawn. Doodle's favourite grunge band comes to play at camp.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Dewch ar daith rownd y byd. Heddiw, teithiwn i Fecsico. Today we go to Mexico to learn about the history of the Aztecs, Mayans, and the 'Día De Los Muertos' festival; plus we eat tortillas.

programme.title: Twm Twrch
programme.desc: Mae eira yng Nghwmtwrch a pawb yn dechrau poeni am Emrys, a ddiflannodd wrth gerdded. It's snowy in Cwmtwrch and everyone is getting concerned for Emrys who disappeared up the mountains.

programme.title: Waw! - Aer
programme.desc: Mae Awi a'r criw yn edrych mlaen i ddarganfod mwy am Aer. Air is the theme, Awi and the 'Waw' crew are excited to learn more.

programme.title: Cywion Bach
programme.desc: Mae'r Cywion Bach wrth eu bodd gyda'r gair Hwyaden. Dere i chwarae, chwerthin a dysgu'r gair gwych gyda nhw. Cwac cwac! The Cywion Bach love today's word, Hwyaden (Duck). Quack quack.

programme.title: Digbi Draig
programme.desc: Mae baromedr Abel yn dweud y bydd stormydd eira yn ardal Glenys o'r goedwig. Abel's barometer predicts snowstorms in Glenys's neck of the woods.

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Dewch ar antur gyda ni i ddweud helo wrth anifeiliaid bach y byd. Yn y rhaglen hon cawn wybod mwy am yr Hiena a'r Mwnci Udo. This time we get to know the Hyena and the Howler monkey.

programme.title: Popi'r Gath
programme.desc: Dydy Sioni ddim yn gallu chware'r gitâr yn dda felly mae Owi'n awgrymu y dylen nhw fynd i chwilio am y 'Gitâr Aur' yn Anialwch yr Haul Gwallgo'. The friends search for the 'Golden Guitar'.

programme.title: Awyr Iach
programme.desc: helpu Cerys ar Fferm Gymunedol Abertawe, cwrdd â Ceiron a lot o ieir, sgwtera i'r ysgol, a chwilota yn y pyllau glân môr gyda Florence a Martha. More outdoorsy fun with the crew.

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.desc: Straeon lliwgar o Affrica am anifeiliaid y byd. Heddiw cawn glywed pam mae Cameleon yn newid lliw. Today we hear why Chameleon changes colour.

programme.title: Caru Canu a Stori
programme.desc: Mae Deris Draig a'i phlant yn cael eu gorfodi i adael eu cartref pan mae pobl yn dechrau adeiladu tai o gwmpas eu hogof. Deris and her children are in a spot of trouble with their home.

programme.title: Octonots
programme.desc: Mae'r Octonots yn brwydro drwy gors i achub fflamingo bach cyn iddo gael ei ddal gan ysglyfaethwyr llwglyd! The Octonauts wade through a swamp to find a lost flamingo chick.

programme.title: Pentre Papur Pop
programme.desc: Ar yr antur popwych heddiw mae Huwcyn yn gwneud ffrind bach newydd. Ond pan mae Crawcyn angen lle i fyw, all Huwcyn wneud un iddo? On today's pop adventure, Hooper makes a froggy friend.

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.desc: Yn rhaglen heddiw, mae Gweni'n gofyn 'Pam bod parotiaid mor lliwgar?', ac mae gan Tad-cu ateb dwl a doniol am wneuthurwr teganau. Today, Gweni asks 'Why are parrots so colourful?'.

programme.title: Olobobs
programme.desc: Mae Gyrdi wedi brifo ei goes ar frigyn ac mae'n hercian braidd, felly mae'r Olobobs yn gwneud iddo deimlo'n well drwy roi plastr ar y briw. Gurdy has hurt his leg on a twig - plaster please.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Mae'r Abadas yn chwarae caffi ac mae gan Hari'r cogydd rywbeth blasus iawn i Ela ei fwyta. It's the restaurant game with the Abadas! Hari and Seren serve up a surprise for Ela to eat.

programme.title: Dreigiau Cadi
programme.desc: Tra mae'r Dreigiau yn chwarae, mae gan Cadi brawf pwysig i'w wneud ar y rheilffordd. While the Dragons play, Cadi has an important test to do at the railway.

programme.title: Sion y Chef
programme.desc: Mae'n galan gaeaf a thra bod Izzy a Magi'n paratoi parti yn y bwyty, mae Siôn a Jac Jôs yn gwersylla mewn coedwig gyfagos. Siôn and Jac Jôs go camping in the woods to conquer their fears.

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Mae Hywel y ffermwr hud yn tywys Betsan ar antur i Fferm Fach i ddod o hyd i arlleg fel bod hi'n gallu pobi bara garlleg. Hywel and Betsan seek garlic so that she can bake garlic bread.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough employs the latest technologies to explore the violence, rivalries and deadly weaponry existing within the world of bugs. This first episode examines the survival tactics of its terrifying residents including killer ants, trap-setting spiders and beetles with the ability to shoot boiling chemicals at their enemies.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster continues his bug-eyed view of the world of creepy-crawlies, revealing how predators defuse the defences of their prey. Highlights include the cockroach wasp, busy preparing a tasty - and very live - treat for its young, the whirligig beetle, which employs a water-based radar system, and the jumping portia spider, which feeds on other arachnids.

programme.title: Secrets of Wild Australia
programme.desc: The importance of waterholes in the dry landscape, secret pockets of paradise and a vital pipeline of life which host an array of birds, insects, fish and freshwater crocodiles.

programme.title: Predators
programme.desc: Tom Hardy presents a look at Canada's Hudson Bay, where a unique community of polar bears are battling to survive in a rapidly changing landscape.

programme.title: Animals Like Us
programme.desc: A line of hermit crabs prepare for a very orderly house swap on a Belize beach. Plus, a chimpanzee that keeps a cat as a pet.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: Alejandra's view of the world has changed after an accident that left her blind in one eye. It's hoped she can overcome her new disability and learn to climb again.

programme.title: Big Cats, Nine Lives
programme.desc: Documentary series following lions, leopards and tigers through the defining stages of their lives, from vulnerable cubhood to power conflicts, reproduction and decline.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough employs the latest technologies to explore the violence, rivalries and deadly weaponry existing within the world of bugs. This first episode examines the survival tactics of its terrifying residents including killer ants, trap-setting spiders and beetles with the ability to shoot boiling chemicals at their enemies.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster continues his bug-eyed view of the world of creepy-crawlies, revealing how predators defuse the defences of their prey. Highlights include the cockroach wasp, busy preparing a tasty - and very live - treat for its young, the whirligig beetle, which employs a water-based radar system, and the jumping portia spider, which feeds on other arachnids.

programme.title: Guardians of the Wild
programme.desc: Zambia's Kafue National Park is an elephant heaven. Here, rescuers teach a herd of orphans the skills they need to make friends in the wild.

programme.title: Patrick Aryee's Wild World
programme.desc: Patrick takes a monumental adventure that explores the breathtaking wild world, beginning by asking whether people's appetite for salmon is wiping out the lynx.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: Super-smart Tulia and Zalipa go missing from Palas Island and the race is on to find them before they get into trouble.

programme.title: Monkey Life
programme.desc: Alison and baby orangutan Sibu enjoy a walk in the park, while primate care staff member Donna is in Spain to collect another rejected orangutan.

programme.title: Monkey Life
programme.desc: Orangutan baby Kiwi makes the journey from Spain to Dorset and meets her new companion Sibu. There are concerns for ageing chimp Butch after a vet visit.

programme.title: Guardians of the Wild
programme.desc: In the heart of the Zambian bush lurks one of the last remaining strongholds for some of Africa's most endangered large carnivores.

programme.title: Patrick Aryee's Wild World
programme.desc: Patrick travels to Yellowstone National Park, where he discovers the positive, top-down domino effect that wolves have on their environment.

programme.title: Land of Primates
programme.desc: Off the coast of Tanzania, baby Kima lives with his family of red colobus monkeys. When he gets lost, he faces a desperate challenge to find them again.

programme.title: Predators

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Azad Desh Ka Andha Kanoon
programme.desc: A brash and honest policeman is torn apart between his duties and saving his family when his own brother is caught in a blue-film scam. He also must protect a sole witness whose life is in danger.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Mafia Raaj
programme.desc: An honest police officer has a mission to wipe out a mafia group. But in the process, he is forced to sacrifice not only his father but also his sister.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1
programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Biwi.Com
programme.desc: When a pandit predicts that Kishan will marry thrice in his lifetime, his wife Shilpa forces him into a second marriage. When the wives start fighting, a third woman arrives from London for Kishan.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Nakshatra

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: The leaders of a secret government agency plan to eliminate several agents as part of a cover-up when they face having their dark secrets exposed. One of the targets is able to evade his fate and go on the run - but his escape is threatened by his dependence on drugs to boost his physical and mental capabilities. Spy thriller sequel, with Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Former government operative Jason Bourne has been in hiding for 12 years after exposing a sinister CIA operation. However, he once again finds himself being hunted down when a former CIA operative gone rogue acquires top secret information - including details of Bourne's own father's involvement in a clandestine scheme. Action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones, Alicia Vikander and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: The amnesiac assassin is living quietly in hiding, until his former employers come after him again and murder his girlfriend. A CIA operation has ended in disaster, and those responsible intend to clear their names by implicating Bourne. As the former secret agent tries to evade the hitmen on his trail, he also struggles to piece together the truth about his past. Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Amnesiac rogue assassin Jason Bourne's long-buried memories are reawakened by a British journalist researching the secret organisation that was responsible for transforming him into a killing machine. Meanwhile, a ruthless CIA director becomes convinced Bourne is still a security risk, and plans to dispose of him once and for all. Third instalment of the spy thriller series, directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Matt Damon, Joan Allen, Julia Stiles, David Strathairn, Paddy Considine, Scott Glenn and Albert Finney.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: The amnesiac assassin is living quietly in hiding, until his former employers come after him again and murder his girlfriend. A CIA operation has ended in disaster, and those responsible intend to clear their names by implicating Bourne. As the former secret agent tries to evade the hitmen on his trail, he also struggles to piece together the truth about his past. Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Amnesiac rogue assassin Jason Bourne's long-buried memories are reawakened by a British journalist researching the secret organisation that was responsible for transforming him into a killing machine. Meanwhile, a ruthless CIA director becomes convinced Bourne is still a security risk, and plans to dispose of him once and for all. Third instalment of the spy thriller series, directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Matt Damon, Joan Allen, Julia Stiles, David Strathairn, Paddy Considine, Scott Glenn and Albert Finney.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: The leaders of a secret government agency plan to eliminate several agents as part of a cover-up when they face having their dark secrets exposed. One of the targets is able to evade his fate and go on the run - but his escape is threatened by his dependence on drugs to boost his physical and mental capabilities. Spy thriller sequel, with Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton.
